scope: Fine arrow endpoints, stroke interruptions/count ambiguity and lead-crossing visibility only; not full SOURCE/RAW review or modern authoring.
sourceCoordinates: Approximate original-PNG pixel locations identify inspected regions, not mathematical coordinates or source measurements.

facts.fact: The legible axial arrow tips in both panels point toward image-top. This is direct tip orientation, not a physical-law deduction.
facts.limit: An occluded/thickened axial mark is not independently called an additional arrowhead.

facts.fact: On the visible lower/front portions of the left panel's nested loops, the arrowheads face image-left; on the corresponding lower/front portions in the right panel, they face image-right.
facts.basis: Endpoint tapers in the three front loop bands were inspected in the nearest-neighbour detail crop.
facts.limit: These local front-arc directions do not establish a separately approved clockwise/counterclockwise mathematical model or every rear arrow endpoint.

facts.fact: The particularly legible rear/middle-loop head in the left panel faces image-right; the corresponding rear/middle head in the right panel faces image-left.
facts.remaining: Some other rear heads merge with axial strokes or degraded print; a complete head-by-head endpoint assignment is not uniquely established here.

facts.fact: There are actual separated ink portions in rear/upper loop bands and interrupted axial strokes inside the loop region. Several loop interruptions coincide with vertical-stroke crossings, but the raster does not uniquely separate every deliberate dash from occlusion/print loss.
facts.remaining: Exact per-loop segment mask distinguishing intentional dash, crossing occlusion and degraded print.
facts.forbiddenInference: Do not turn all rear halves into one dashed style, join all interrupted portions, or relabel axial dashes as loop dashes.

figures.notPerformed: No Maxwell/right-hand-rule/handedness deduction, source regeneration, SVG analysis, complete inventory replay or source approval.

facts.fact: The upper horizontal conductor head faces image-left; the left vertical conductor head faces image-bottom; the lower horizontal conductor head faces image-right.
facts.basis: Individual tip orientations in the original whole image, with the bottom direction also visible in the contiguous lower detail.

facts.fact: Several legible gap-field arrowheads face image-bottom. Occluded/thickened marks are not promoted to confirmed extra arrowheads or independently assigned per trace.
facts.remaining: A complete assignment of one endpoint direction to every gap trace.

facts.fact: Near-vertical gap strokes repeatedly merge with the nested loop strokes and plate borders. Visible upper stems, lower tails and isolated interior stems do not uniquely pair into one exact trace inventory in this raster.
facts.remaining: Exact E-trace count together with a one-to-one upper/interior/lower segment and occlusion table.
facts.forbiddenInference: Do not count lower tails as the total number of traces, invent missing stems, infer count from symmetry/spacing or normalize all traces into a regular grid.

facts.fact: The legible front-loop arrowheads in the left loop set face image-left. The outer/front arrow in the gap loop set also has a visible image-left-facing tip.
facts.remaining: Some inner/rear gap-loop heads merge with field strokes; a complete per-loop head endpoint table is unresolved.
facts.limit: No direction for an obscured head is supplied from a circuit rule or from the readable neighbouring loop.

facts.fact: The lower plate's front edge and the upper endpoint of the lower lead are separated by a visible white interval. No touching ink junction or explicit junction dot is drawn at that location.
facts.region: Around original x388, y277-283; location is approximate.
facts.limit: This is an ink-gap/visibility fact, not proof that the physical circuit is electrically open. A concealed plate attachment cannot be reconstructed from these pixels.

facts.fact: The lower lead contains irregular thickened/protruding ink, but no unequivocal tapered arrowhead endpoint can be isolated in the retained raster.
facts.remaining: Whether a particular protrusion is an intentional direction marker, and its exact endpoint direction.

facts.fact: At the left loop set, the conductor is visible in portions above and below the loop band and has black meetings plus white interruptions within it. There is no separate electrical-junction-dot notation on the loop intersections.
facts.remaining: Exact stroke-by-stroke front/rear occlusion ordering at all conductor/loop crossings; ink meetings alone do not define physical wiring junctions.

figures.notPerformed: No circuit-convention/right-hand-rule deduction, E-trace restoration, source regeneration, full raw/source rereview or modern drawing.

disposition: PARTIAL_FINE_FACTS_OBSERVED_REMAINDER_BOUNDED_HOLD; no complete source, modern semantic or course approval.
